removal_gate: Execute all replacement regressions before removing the four bounded paths. This manifest does not authorize live acquisition, old-checkpoint import or deletion of user artifacts.
rollback: Revert the integration commit; exact original tracked bytes remain at baseline_commit. Do not convert or overwrite user run directories.

removed_paths.reachability: Imported only by its corresponding Vitest file; no package/default build entrypoint
Imported only by its corresponding Vitest file; direct standalone fixture CLI
Vitest discovery: 10 ordinary cases plus 6 parameterized cases

old_test_cases.name: rejects an unexpected plan schema instead of normalising it away
old_test_cases.reason: Unknown schema remains rejected, never normalized into authority.

old_test_cases.name: accepts official host-only and offline policy constraints
old_test_cases.reason: The source identity is internally constructed and production endpoint inputs do not exist. The explicit test capability accepts only a numeric local port.

old_test_cases.name: derives contiguous byte segments from plan budget and file size
old_test_cases.reason: Full-CAR-from-zero segmentation is replaced by index-derived requested ranges. Determinism and bounded chunking survive.

old_test_cases.name: writes all segments in order, validates receipts, and publishes complete summary
old_test_cases.reason: Complete means verified planned request publications, not a complete CAR or proven chain coverage.

old_test_cases.name: rejects mismatched Content-Range and unexpected entity length
old_test_cases.reason: Exact range and streamed entity size are validated before publication.

old_test_cases.name: supports restart through checkpoint hydration only when provenance and plan hash align
old_test_cases.reason: Resume revalidates durable plan/source/index/code/toolchain and executable identity, not caller-supplied checkpoint claims.

old_test_cases.name: continues capture after resume using the checkpoint run identity
old_test_cases.reason: The immutable run identity persists; partial transport evidence cannot be transferred to another run.

old_test_cases.name: requires the request budget and verifies the complete raw hash explicitly
old_test_cases.reason: Preserve request accounting and exact content hashes. Retire HTTP200 success and whole-CAR hash claims for partial ranges; per-range hash is not whole-source/CID verification.

old_test_cases.name: rejects duplicate segment observations and supports single-segment 200 responses
old_test_cases.reason: Duplicate publication is forbidden. HTTP200 is rejected even for one range; an unexpected full response is never accepted.

old_test_cases.name: rejects checkpoint files with duplicate receipts
old_test_cases.reason: Exact request/receipt/directory identity replaces an editable completed-segment list.

old_test_cases.name: accepts an empty override environment
old_test_cases.reason: No environment/URL/backend consumer exists in the replacement transport; absence of retarget capability replaces parsing empty override dictionaries.

old_test_cases.name: fails closed when JETSTREAMER_HTTP_BASE_URL is non-empty
old_test_cases.reason: Retargeting remains impossible: no Jetstreamer/env client is constructed; the local endpoint accepts no host or URL.

old_test_cases.name: fails closed when ARCHIVE_BASE is non-empty
old_test_cases.reason: Retargeting remains impossible; no archive-base or environment input exists.

old_test_cases.name: fails closed when ARCHIVE_BACKEND is non-empty
old_test_cases.reason: No backend selection or environment input exists.

old_test_cases.name: fails closed when JETSTREAMER_S3_BUCKET is non-empty
old_test_cases.reason: No S3 client, feature or environment input exists.

old_test_cases.name: fails closed when ARCHIVE_S3_ENDPOINT is non-empty
old_test_cases.reason: No S3 endpoint or environment input exists.

old_test_cases.name: fails closed when AWS_ENDPOINT_URL is non-empty
old_test_cases.reason: No AWS endpoint or environment input exists.

old_test_cases.name: closes a half-open slot window and refuses a full-epoch CAR
old_test_cases.reason: Preserve bounded window/full-epoch rejection. A caller-labelled window does not establish semantic slot membership or coverage.

old_test_cases.name: refuses a requested window that equals the full epoch span
old_test_cases.reason: The epoch is mandatory and exact; optional-epoch bypass is rejected.

old_test_cases.name: marks the documented provisional example without approving it
replacement: keeps the inherited draft unapproved and offline
old_test_cases.reason: Preserve the no-approval invariant without making any proposed authentic range an operational constant.

old_test_cases.name: distinguishes UNAVAILABLE, GAP and QUARANTINED and never zero-fills
old_test_cases.reason: Missing never becomes zero. Caller observedSlots asserting CLOSED/GAP chain coverage is retired; index absence, transport failure and unavailable domain counts remain distinct.

old_test_cases.name: writes raw bytes, identity and receipt before any parse
old_test_cases.reason: Preserve original pre-decode Raw/receipt identity. Arbitrary caller-supplied nonempty CID is not verification; CID and root membership remain unavailable.

old_test_cases.name: refuses parse when persist artifacts are missing
old_test_cases.reason: No partial/missing pair is exposed as a verified published object. No domain decoder is introduced.

old_test_cases.name: renders deterministic progress only through an injected writer
old_test_cases.reason: Progress is derived from fixture/durable state, with unavailable counts explicit; deterministic JSON/Markdown is the visible output.

old_test_cases.name: does not run the demo when an override is present
old_test_cases.reason: No caller host, URL, proxy, backend, S3 or environment source selection exists; local fixture transport cannot retarget an archive.

old_test_cases.name: keeps the committed draft plan unapproved and offline
replacement: keeps the inherited draft unapproved and offline
old_test_cases.reason: The exact old draft remains preserved and explicitly unapproved; no budget or lease decision is changed.
